e75208a17e6da1ac.title: Brijean DJ Set supported by Colloboh
e75208a17e6da1ac.desc: 21+ OnlyJoin us at Camilles at The Bellwether for a DJ Set from Brijean!Brijean Bio:Since their debut as Brijean, the project of percussionist/singer-songwriter Brijean Murphy (the percussive heartbeat for live bands like Mitski, Poolside, and Toro y Moi) and multi-instrumentalist/producer Doug Stuart has moved with ingenuity, fusing psych-pop abstraction with dancefloor sensibilities. Brijean engages different sides of themselves, the paradox of being alive. Murphys layered percussion and expressive vocals coupled with Stuarts production and harmonic palette evoked shades of disco, 90s house, and a sly pop sensibility. A smooth, sumptuous, and soulful record, said Bandcamp, who helped propel the groups early following. This event is 21 and over. Any ticket holder unable to present valid identification indicating that they are at least 21 years of age will not be admitted to this event, and will not be eligible for a refund.

Evan Hansen is about to get the one thing he’s always wanted: a chance to finally fit in. From the Tony, Oscar and Golden Globe-winning songwriting team Ben Pasek and Justin Paul (The Greatest Showman, La La Land), DEAR EVAN HANSEN is a new musical about life and the way we live it. Opening in November 2019. Book your tickets today.

e7793e7774576d24.title: Letters to Santa
e7793e7774576d24.desc: November 16 – December 5 1605 E. Burnley St., Camarillo Write a letter to Santa and drop it in the big red mailbox at the Community Center and he will write a letter back to you! Use your own stationery to  write your letter , or you can download our letter template   to fill out and mail to Santa. Be sure to include your name & address so Santa can reply!  No postage stamps are necessary.  If you do not provide a return address, the PVRPD elves won’t know where to send your letter and will be so sad… Bring your letter to the Community Center and drop it in the giant red mailbox located right in front of the Administrative Office at  1605 E. Burnley Street, Camarillo . Take a photo   of you or your kids placing the letter in the mailbox and share it with us on social media using #PVRPDLettersToSanta on  Facebook ,  or  Instagram . Santa will write a letter back to each person who placed an envelope in the big red mailbox  ( as long as they included their name & mailing address ) . The reply should come in the mail before Christmas to the address provided.

e7275890e84d936f.title: Hart Rampage
e7275890e84d936f.desc: The William S. Hart Regiment is hosting its 42nd annual Rampage Marching Band Competition on Saturday, November 7th. The day-long competition will be held at the College of the Canyons Cougar Stadium, located at 26455 Rockwell Canyon Road in Valencia, CA. Over 30 bands from Southern California and surrounding areas will be participating in the event. Along with the band performances, there will also be food vendors, merchandise booths, and raffle prizes. You’ll want to make sure to stay until the end of the day to witness our traditional mass drumline! Immediately following the drumline performance, we will hold our awards ceremony. Ticket prices are $15 for adults, and $12 for children and seniors, and will be available to purchase on site. Parking: Priority parking is available in Lot 8 for $5, or park for free in Lot 7. For more information visit: https://www.hartregiment.com/rampage
